rebuttal.innocent_explanation: The operating cash flow decomposition shows net income rose $24.5M and non-cash adjustments rose $82.5M, but cash from operating assets/liabilities fell $370.1M; the cited $193.9M inventory build (early deliveries for seasonal floor sets) and $90.8M larger receivables increase (shipment timing) account for $284.7M of that drop, consistent with the reported working capital changes.
